description: PLANNED (plan T18; OpenVibe.Watch is not built yet): Create, change, pause, resume and delete a watch: POST /api/v1/watches, PATCH /api/v1/watches/:id, POST /api/v1/watches/:id/pause, POST /api/v1/watches/:id/resume and DELETE /api/v1/watches/:id. It becomes active, and enters generated/openapi/watch.json, when OpenVibe.Watch implements the routes.
